mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_measurement (device_id, device_name, floor_name, collected_at, energy_kwh, current_a, current_b, current_c, working) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{floorName}, #{collectedAt}, #{energyKwh}, #{currentA}, #{currentB}, #{currentC}, #{working}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE device_name = VALUES(device_name), floor_name = VALUES(floor_name), energy_kwh = VALUES(energy_kwh), current_a = VALUES(current_a), current_b = VALUES(current_b), current_c = VALUES(current_c), working = VALUES(working)
mapper.select: SELECT device_id, device_name, floor_name, collected_at, energy_kwh FROM device_measurement WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND collected_at <= #{time} AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT device_id, device_name, floor_name, collected_at, energy_kwh FROM device_measurement WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND collected_at >= #{time} AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL ORDER BY collected_at ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT latest.device_id, latest.device_name, latest.floor_name FROM ( SELECT device_id FROM device_measurement GROUP BY device_id ) devices JOIN device_measurement latest ON latest.id = ( SELECT latest_sample.id FROM device_measurement latest_sample WHERE latest_sample.device_id = devices.device_id ORDER BY latest_sample.collected_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE 1 = 1
AND latest.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND latest.floor_name = #{floorName}
ORDER BY latest.device_id
